coverAlts: Japanese affection and register — an L0 demonstration classroom
coverCaptions: Schematic with three paths from speaker to register. You to a friend, affection, casual register (suki da yo). You to someone you respect, first confession, polite register (suki desu). You to a long-term partner, deep affection, intimate register (aishiteru). The schematic states that register is a function of addressee, relationship and setting.
